question: Can an owner develop and run a reviewed experiment through a guided question-and-answer interface without bypassing existing scientific or execution gates?
design: Local software development regressions. Actual components, API and isolated Postgres; synthetic Google identity, model responses and cloud dispatch. No scientific finding or held-out model evaluation.
pass_criteria: Existing answers are reused and the first unresolved question is shown; unknowns stay empty
Direct user answers map to explicit plan or protocol fields and save immutable versions; no model output is silently applied
Methods can be specified without hand-writing protocol JSON; original advanced editing remains available
Missing, unsaved or invalid inputs and failed or critical reviews block progression to execution
Readiness requires latest fresh comprehension and critic reviews of the exact current packet plus owner acceptance
Configuration freezes before queueing; there is no automatic launch from chat or a planning recommendation
Save and model failures preserve drafts and invocation identities; no automatic model retries
Unavailable runners and workers are explicit; previous campaigns and evidence remain accessible
Mobile and desktop, light and dark, downloads, navigation and meaningful missing states remain usable
conditional_checks: Actual published model answers to guided coaching requests
release: Local implementation only. Existing backend prompts, persistence and readiness architecture are reused. A new explicit deployment request is required.
